dedupe_keys.name: rts gmlc reliability test system grid modernization lab consortium

description: RTS-GMLC is the Reliability Test System of the Grid Modernization Lab Consortium, an updated version of the IEEE RTS-96 test system developed to support production cost modelling research. The repository's RTS_Data folder holds source data in open CSV files describing the whole test system, and a FormattedData folder with conversions for specific grid tools, including MATPOWER, PowerWorld and PSS/E, each with a conversion script and tool solutions. A summary of the updates from RTS-96 is kept in the repository, and reliability calculations with the RTS3 program by Gene Preston are linked. The data describe a synthetic test system, not a real utility territory, so coverage is a fictional region used for methods testing. It is published by the Grid Modernization Laboratory Consortium on GitHub (latest tag v0.2.3, last commit October 2025), free to download. Caveats: no licence file was found at the repository root when checked, so reuse terms should be confirmed, and update activity is low. Simulation uses are production cost and network flow modelling, optimisation, capacity planning and reliability studies. Related records: its MATPOWER-format files run in model-matpower and model-powermodels-jl.
